title: Live output proxy verification and tool-invoke compatibility validation for new model onboardings
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Goal: Create and run a deterministic verification pass that validates streaming output behavior and tool/function-call semantics for newly onboarded models and their pinned versions. This ticket covers: the proxy harness used by the verification suite, gating logic for version pinning, publishing compatibility metadata to the performance catalog, and a small smoke-suite to catch regressions in live streaming + external tool invocation scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible proxy harness exists that can mediate model streaming responses and simulate tool endpoints (HTTP POST/GRPC) for function invocations.
The harness validates backpressure behavior: chunk ordering, partial message framing, and graceful closure when tools return early/late errors.
Version pinning checks: onboarding job creates a 'streaming-compatible' boolean and a 'pinned-compatible-versions' list in the model metadata when tests pass.
Compatibility results (pass/fail + short diagnostics) are published to the performance catalog and surfaced in the onboarding pipeline UI.
Smoke suite executes on every model snapshot upload and fails the onboarding job for high-severity incompatibilities (e.g., broken handshake, truncated function payloads).
Documentation and runbook for how to interpret failures and request re-certification are added to Confluence.
tasks: Design proxy harness API and request/response fixture format (owner: Luca)
Implement streaming proxy with deterministic chunking and latency injection knobs (owner: Eng-Proxy team)
Add simulated tool endpoints that cover success, 4xx/5xx, timeouts, and slow-streaming bodies (owner: Integration team)
Create version pin gating logic in the onboarding pipeline to mark model metadata (owner: Onboarding infra)
Integrate compatibility run into model snapshot CI and the onboarding pipeline (owner: CI team)
Publish human-readable compatibility summary into performance catalog UI and expose machine-readable JSON for downstream tooling (owner: Catalog team)
Write runbook and failure triage doc with example failure patterns (owner: Reliability)
Add alerting rules for surge of compatibility failures during nightly onboarding runs (owner: SRE)
Add unit and integration tests for harness; target 90% deterministic pass rate in CI (owner: QA)
Schedule a cross-team review with PM/Design/SRE before merging (owner: Luca)
